clues.it: Dario era nella 6ª colonna, accanto a una poltrona e a ovest di Elena.
clues.en: Dario was in the 6th column, beside a flight seat and west of Elena.

clues.it: Elena era accanto a una grata, a una consolle e a nord di Carla.
clues.en: Elena was beside a floor grate, a console and north of Carla.

clues.it: LA VITTIMA. Era da solo con l'assassino.
clues.en: The Victim. Was alone with the murderer.

clues.it: Olga era nella 4ª colonna e accanto a una criocapsula, ma non era accanto a un droide.
clues.en: Olga was in the 4th column and beside a cryopod, but was not beside a droid.

clues.it: Paolo era accanto a una consolle, a un reattore e a nord di Marta.
clues.en: Paolo was beside a console, a reactor and north of Marta.

clues.it: Rosa era nella 1ª colonna, accanto a una poltrona e a ovest di Sergio.
clues.en: Rosa was in the 1st column, beside a flight seat and west of Sergio.

clues.it: Sergio era accanto a un'antenna e a nord di Carla.
clues.en: Sergio was beside an antenna and north of Carla.

clues.it: Ugo era a nord di Carla e in Laboratorio.
clues.en: Ugo was north of Carla and in the Lab.

clues.it: Carla era nella 9ª riga, a ovest di Elena e in Serra.
clues.en: Carla was in the 9th row, west of Elena and in the Greenhouse.

clues.it: Marta era nella 5ª colonna e nella 10ª riga, ma non era accanto a un droide.
clues.en: Marta was in the 5th column and in the 10th row, but was not beside a droid.

general_clues.en: 5 in the west half of the grid.
5 in the north half of the grid.

steps.it: L'indizio di Dario lascia una sola casella libera: riga 1ª, colonna 6ª.
steps.en: Dario's own clue leaves a single free square: row 1st, column 6th.

steps.it: Dario può stare solo nella 1ª riga: escludendola, a Elena resta una sola casella: riga 2ª, colonna 10ª.
steps.en: Dario can only be in the 1st row: ruling it out leaves Elena a single square: row 2nd, column 10th.
